sloka: स लक्ष्मणं महातेजाः सुग्रीवं च हरीश्वरम् ।सत्क्रियार्थं क्रियादक्षः स्मितपूर्वमुवाच ह ।। ६.१९.३७ ।।।।
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaṁ mahātejāḥ sugrīvaṁ ca harīśvaram ।satkriyārthaṁ kriyādakṣaḥ smitapūrvamuvāca ha ।। 6.19.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Heroic Rama having said that way to both, Lakshmana and Sugriva replied thus respectfully following tradition (with folded hands).
